name: MOSS-Image SFT (Q4)
description: OpenMOSS's MOSS-Image, fine-tuned to follow instructions. Strong at clear, accurate text inside images (signs, posters, whiteboards, labeled diagrams, Chinese as well as English), and it can place text and objects where a prompt or a JSON layout says. A 5B image transformer with Qwen3.5 9B as its text encoder and the FLUX.2 small-decoder VAE: leejet's Q4_K quantization of the transformer and a Q4_K_M encoder, about 9.3 GB of downloads. Careful rather than fast: 50 steps with guidance means about a hundred transformer passes per image. Apache 2.0 throughout, so fully commercial-friendly.
